title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Expanded agricultural value chains and better integration of small scale farmers into IVCs in the Nashik and Aurangabad-Amravati regions

Post harvest losses reduced on average from 30% (2008) to 21% of product throughput Progress/Status: Activities were not completed. Data Source: Report from Agricultural Marketing Information Network and other relevant government agencies and Nashik and Aurangabad- Amravati marketing data and statistics Actual value:

An additional 20% of value added captured within the IVC Progress/Status: Activities were not completed. Data Source: Report from Agricultural Marketing Information Network and other relevant government agencies and Nashik and Aurangabad- Amravati marketing data and statistics Baseline value:

At least 30% of the farmer groups enter into long-term agreements with the IVC Progress/Status: Activities were not completed. Data Source: Farmer groups/producer associations annual report and marketing records Baseline value:

At least 30,000 producers supplying more than 250,000 mt of HVCs to modern value adding infrastructure Progress/Status: Activities were not completed. Data Source: Report from Agricultural Marketing Information Network and other relevant government agencies and Nashik and Aurangabad- Amravati marketing data and statistics
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. IVCs Infrastructure in Nashik and Aurangabad-Amravati regions set up and functional Indicator: 15 market sites (with 1 hubs and 14 spokes) upgraded or developed with modern IVC infrastructure, site and linking infrastructure (e.g. roads) Data Source: Private concessionaire's accomplishment reports Target year: 2015 Target value: 15

Output: 1. IVCs Infrastructure in Nashik and Aurangabad-Amravati regions set up and functional Indicator: Power supply outage frequency and duration within the IVC facilities reduced by 50% compared to consumers supplied from local distribution line experiencing 8 hours power shortage daily Data Source: Report from Electricity Regulatory Commission/ Maharashtra State Electricity Board and other relevant government agencies and project progress review and monitoring report Target year: 2015

Output: 1. IVCs Infrastructure in Nashik and Aurangabad-Amravati regions set up and functional Indicator: Water supply within the IVC facilities satisfies 95% of demand at all times Data Source: Report from Water Resources Regulation Authority and other relevant government agencies and project progress review and monitoring report Target year: 2015

Output: 2. IVC stakeholders effectively participate in and manage IVCs Indicator: 2 PPP contracts completed successfully by 2013 and properly monitored Data Source: Project progress review and monitoring report by Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist Baseline value: 0 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2015 Target value: 2
Output: 2. IVC stakeholders effectively participate in and manage IVCs Indicator: 50% of IVC stakeholders trained on VC technology and management systems (Baseline = 0, 20% female) Target year: 2015

Output: 3. Project Management support strengthened Indicator: Concessionaire contract management and monitoring system institutionalized within the implementing agency by the end of 2013 Data Source: MIS user feedback report Target year: 2013

Output: 3. Project Management support strengthened Indicator: PMU officials trained on the job in managing a transparent bidding process, awarding a PPP contract in agribusiness infrastructure by the end of 2012. Progress/Status: TAG1 consultants are supporting MSAMB in this regard Data Source: Training modules/ proceedings and post-training report Target year: 2012

Output: 3. Project Management support strengthened Indicator: Technical advisory group for PMU formed within 6 months from project effectiveness. Data Source: Project MIS and database Target year: 2012
